tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, close to the reported critical range of 2.50–2.68, but does not cross it. The targeted high-gradient probe can identify whether an avalanche decline occurs.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche law to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five gradients are below the stated critical range, leaving the avalanche threshold and strength unidentified.
The pilot data do not distinguish these smooth alternatives from a threshold-driven decline at higher gradients.
A high-gradient probe more directly tests the unresolved threshold.
It is irrelevant to identifying the high-gradient mechanism.
